title: Fuobe Speak · talking portraits
description: A portrait and a voice track you supply (local/speak/portrait.png of a consenting person, local/speak/voice.wav, 5–15 s of clear speech). Measures lip-sync (a mouth-motion / audio-envelope proxy; SyncNet when you install it, see the README), temporal consistency and identity against the portrait. O11 adds the InfiniteTalk 'Higgsfield-like defaults' preset and Wan 2.2 S2V route.
